zh-CN.title: 跨测评上下文边界
zh-CN.summary: 这一模块只说明相关测评可以怎样辅助阅读 EQ-60 结果。它不是把多个测试合成一个更“真实”的结论。
zh-CN.how_to_use: 把 MBTI、大五、九型、RIASEC 等结果当作不同问题框架下的反思线索：它们可以帮助提出问题，但不能改写 EQ 分数、替代 EQ-60 自我报告，或证明现实行为。
zh-CN.claim_boundary: 不用于情商能力排名、职业预测、招聘筛选、临床诊断、关系结局判断、固定人格标签或高风险决策。

en.title: Cross-Assessment Context Boundary
en.summary: This module only explains how related assessments can support reading the EQ-60 result. It does not combine multiple tests into a more “true” conclusion.
en.how_to_use: Treat MBTI, Big Five, Enneagram, RIASEC, and related results as reflection signals from different question frameworks. They can help form better questions, but they do not rewrite EQ scores, replace EQ-60 self-report, or prove real-world behavior.
en.claim_boundary: Not for emotional-ability ranking, career prediction, hiring, clinical diagnosis, relationship-outcome judgment, fixed identity labels, or high-stakes decisions.

meta.risk_notes: Cross-assessment context is reflective only. It must not become deterministic profile fusion, job/hiring prediction, clinical interpretation, ability ranking, or relationship-outcome judgment.

zh-CN.title: EQ 和 MBTI 怎么一起看
zh-CN.summary: MBTI 可以提供偏好、精力使用和信息处理风格，EQ-60 则呈现本次作答中的情绪与关系自我感知。两者适合并列阅读，不适合合成一个总分或标签。
zh-CN.how_to_use: 先看 EQ-60 的四维信号，再用 MBTI 提出更具体的反思问题：哪些场景会放大这个信号，哪些只是表达风格差异。
zh-CN.claim_boundary: 不要用跨测评组合推断情商高低、真实能力、岗位匹配、招聘结论、临床状态、关系成败或稳定人格优劣。

en.title: How EQ and MBTI Work Together
en.summary: MBTI can add preferences, energy use, and information-processing style; EQ-60 presents emotional-relational self-perception in this response set. They are useful side by side, not as one fused score or label.
en.how_to_use: Start with the EQ-60 dimension signals, then use MBTI to ask more precise reflection questions: which contexts may amplify the signal, and which parts may be style differences.
en.claim_boundary: Do not use cross-assessment combinations to infer EQ level, true ability, job fit, hiring conclusions, clinical status, relationship outcomes, or fixed personality quality.

meta.risk_notes: Related-assessment context only; no deterministic fusion or high-stakes inference.

en.title: MBTI × self-awareness: lower self-report

Treat it as a signal for further observation, not as evidence of low ability or a personality flaw.
